nativeSelection.source: Cloudflare zone Security Events sampled logs

contextJoin.userAgentInterpretation: Matches the controlled Python urllib execution; provider UA is a request claim, not a general authenticated operator identity.
contextJoin.rayUniqueness: Not guaranteed by Cloudflare; corroborating time/host/path/method/query are required here.
contextJoin.sampleInterpretation: Returned record interval only, not evidence of complete Security Events coverage.

clockInterpretationCorrection.correctedMeaning: Original checkedAt was sampled after body reading and processing. The values compare an observation clock with the provider event second, not a measured response-arrival clock.

capture.method: Selected-field projection of the already displayed native event-export data URI, with expanded UI agreement.
capture.downloadFailure: One download listener timeout/reset; no event file found. No export retry or extra own-site request.

currentCodeReview.calibrationEvaluator: Incomplete measurements stay outside classifier abstentions/confusion matrix. This ordinary release control is not registered in that trial protocol.
currentCodeReview.fetcherTrialLedger: Requires its own marked plan and Worker capture; no event is invented for this rejected check.

primarySources.claim: 1010 is a browser-signature access denial. Separate managed-zone exception names pages.dev/workers.dev and Pages custom domains.
primarySources.limit: Our source declares a Worker Custom Domain, so that exception is not automatically applicable.

primarySources.claim: BIC evaluates headers including missing/nonstandard UA.
primarySources.limit: Not an RFC9421 cryptographic verification verdict or proof of malicious intent.

primarySources.claim: Security Events reports actioned/flagged security events, not requests; can sample and can have multiple events per request.
primarySources.limit: One event with sampleInterval1 does not establish coverage or a population blocking rate.

primarySources.claim: Ray IDs are useful for investigation but not guaranteed unique for every request.
primarySources.limit: Join uses context rather than assuming a globally unique request key.

primarySources.claim: Workers runs after WAF and Access.
primarySources.limit: Architecture is not a per-request invocation or storage trace.

primarySources.claim: BIC is independent of the Ruleset Engine.
primarySources.limit: Do not assign this event a guessed named ruleset phase.

limits: Native service/rule IDs establish the observed BIC block. The specific decisive signal and historical effective configuration are not reconstructed.
Browser-signature heuristics are separate from RFC9421 cryptographic proofs, verified-agent identity and per-action purpose.
Ray IDs are not guaranteed globally unique; the match also uses timestamp, host, path, method and query.
Security events may be multiple per request and sampled; sampleInterval1 on this record does not prove completeness.
Cloudflare documents Workers after WAF/Access and BIC separately from Ruleset Engine phases. This is architectural context, not an independent Worker/storage trace.
The Worker Custom Domain declaration does not automatically inherit the Pages custom-domain/workers.dev special no-log exception.
One controlled benign-purpose client block is not a population false-positive rate or proof that the service is misconfigured.
Missing/unobserved downstream measurement remains unknown, not zero or classifier abstention.

checks.independentReadOnlyReview: No material overclaim; no extra query, trial or regrading.
